#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Reproduction script generated by kimi_k3_estimates.py.
# Run with: bash commands.txt
set -euo pipefail
export MPLCONFIGDIR=/Users/mimehta/.codex/worktrees/cd94/kimi-k3/aiconfigurator_estimates/results/kimi-k3-20260913T204028746139Z/matplotlib
AICONFIGURATOR=/Users/mimehta/aiconfigurator/.venv/bin/aiconfigurator
COMMON=(--model-path moonshotai/Kimi-K3 --system h200_sxm --isl 1000 --osl 1000 --ctx-tokens 1000 --database-mode SILICON)
# --attention-dp-size N: replicate the attention computation across N data-parallel groups.
# --moe-tp-size N: split each MoE expert tensor computation across N GPUs.
# --moe-ep-size N: distribute the MoE expert set across N GPUs (expert parallelism).
# For TP8xDP2, attention DP=2, MoE TP=1, and MoE EP=16 use all 16 GPUs:
# two attention replicas, with experts distributed across the full GPU group.

run_estimate() {
  local label=$1 batch=$2 mode=$3; shift 3
  echo "# ${label}"
  "$AICONFIGURATOR" cli estimate "${COMMON[@]}" --batch-size "$batch" --estimate-mode "$mode" "$@" --detail source
}

# estimates
run_estimate "estimates/baseline" 1 agg --backend vllm --moe-ep-size 16 --moe-tp-size 1 --backend-version 0.24.0 --tp-size 16 --pp-size 1 --attention-dp-size 1
run_estimate "estimates/vllm-tp16" 1 agg --backend vllm --moe-ep-size 1 --moe-tp-size 16 --backend-version 0.24.0 --tp-size 16 --pp-size 1 --attention-dp-size 1
run_estimate "estimates/sglang-tp16" 1 agg --backend sglang --moe-ep-size 1 --moe-tp-size 16 --backend-version 0.5.14 --tp-size 16 --pp-size 1 --attention-dp-size 1

# parallelism
for backend in vllm sglang; do
  if [[ "$backend" == vllm ]]; then version=0.24.0; else version=0.5.14; fi
  for tp in 16 8 4 2 1; do
    pp=$((16 / tp))
    for ep in 1 2 4 8 16; do
      if (( ep <= tp )); then
        moe_tp=$((tp / ep))
        run_estimate "parallelism/${backend}-tp${tp}-pp${pp}-ep${ep}" 1 agg --backend "$backend" --backend-version "$version" --tp-size "$tp" --pp-size "$pp" --attention-dp-size 1 --moe-tp-size "$moe_tp" --moe-ep-size "$ep"
      fi
    done
  done
done

# refinement: context sweeps
for backend in vllm sglang; do
  if [[ "$backend" == vllm ]]; then version=0.24.0; else version=0.5.14; fi
  for ep in 1 16; do
    if [[ "$backend" == sglang && "$ep" == 16 ]]; then continue; fi
    moe_tp=$((16 / ep))
    for ctx in 128 256 512 1000 2048; do
      run_estimate "refinement/${backend}-ep${ep}-ctx${ctx}" 1 agg --backend "$backend" --backend-version "$version" --moe-tp-size "$moe_tp" --moe-ep-size "$ep" --ctx-tokens "$ctx"
    done
  done
done

# refinement: hybrid database and disaggregated cases
for backend in vllm sglang; do
  if [[ "$backend" == vllm ]]; then version=0.24.0; else version=0.5.14; fi
  for ep in 1 2 4 8 16; do
    moe_tp=$((16 / ep))
    run_estimate "refinement/${backend}-ep${ep}-hybrid" 1 agg --backend "$backend" --backend-version "$version" --moe-tp-size "$moe_tp" --moe-ep-size "$ep" --database-mode HYBRID
  done
  run_estimate "refinement/${backend}-disagg-8-plus-8" 1 disagg --backend "$backend" --backend-version "$version" --tp-size 8 --pp-size 1 --attention-dp-size 1 --moe-tp-size 8 --moe-ep-size 1 --prefill-batch-size 1 --decode-batch-size 1 --prefill-num-workers 1 --decode-num-workers 1
done

# report comparisons
for c in 1 2 4 8 16 32 64 128 256 512; do
  batch=$(((c + 1 - 1) / 1))
  run_estimate "report/TP16-c${c}" "$batch" agg --backend vllm --backend-version 0.24.0 --tp-size 16 --pp-size 1 --attention-dp-size 1 --moe-tp-size 16 --moe-ep-size 1
done
for c in 1 2 4 8 16 32 64 128 256 512; do
  batch=$(((c + 1 - 1) / 1))
  run_estimate "report/TEP16-c${c}" "$batch" agg --backend vllm --backend-version 0.24.0 --tp-size 16 --pp-size 1 --attention-dp-size 1 --moe-tp-size 1 --moe-ep-size 16
done
for c in 1 2 4 8 16 32 64 128 256 512; do
  batch=$(((c + 2 - 1) / 2))
  run_estimate "report/TP8xPP2-c${c}" "$batch" agg --backend vllm --backend-version 0.24.0 --tp-size 8 --pp-size 2 --attention-dp-size 1 --moe-tp-size 8 --moe-ep-size 1
done
for c in 1 2 4 8 16; do
  batch=$(((c + 2 - 1) / 2))
  run_estimate "report/TP8xDP2-c${c}" "$batch" agg --backend vllm --backend-version 0.24.0 --tp-size 8 --pp-size 1 --attention-dp-size 2 --moe-tp-size 1 --moe-ep-size 16
done
